subject: Information Theory
title: Animal Communication
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Animal Communication.

hook.text: Honeybees dance to communicate flower locations—angle for direction, duration for distance. It's a spatial code.

buildup.text: Animal signals range from simple alarm calls to complex bird songs with hundreds of distinct syllables.

discovery.text: Information theory quantifies the capacity: vervet monkeys have about 3-4 distinct alarm calls. That's roughly 2 bits.

twist.text: Human language has effectively unlimited capacity through combinatorial syntax. No animal comes close.

climax.text: The gap between animal and human communication is a gap in channel capacity—syntax unlocks infinite combinations.

punchline.text: Animals signal. Humans compose. Syntax makes the difference.

quiz.question: What gives human language effectively unlimited capacity?
